rows.counterargument: THE DEPARTURE TIME IS DISPUTED THREE WAYS AND THEY CANNOT ALL BE TRUE: (a) wheels-up ~07:08-07:14 MT, roughly five hours BEFORE the shot, per the Flightradar24 export; (b) Candace Owens's 'nuclear flight logs' - power-up 9:05 am, track goes dark, reactivates 17 minutes after the shot, idles to 1:29 pm; (c) @ProjectConstitu / @nihilox - it never left Provo at all and launched from Dugway Proving Ground's Michael Army Airfield with the transponder off until clear of R-6404. Part of the spread is a UTC-versus-local conversion error circulating uncorrected (13:08 UTC = 07:08 MDT, published as both). SU-BND's unexplained 68-minute Provo->Provo sortie on 5 Sept has an exact twin: SU-BGM flew a 55-minute Provo->Provo loop on 10 Apr 2025 - the signature of a post-maintenance functional check flight. If the September loop is anomalous, consistency requires treating the April one the same way. Duncan Aviation's Egyptian Air Force account dates to 1999.
rows.notes: ADDED FROM THE OVERLAP PAGE, which had no row in this file. THE ONLY DATE IN THE ENTIRE RECORD THAT IS A SAME-DAY, SAME-AIRPORT OVERLAP BY ANY DEFINITION, INCLUDING THE SCEPTICS'. From 23 May to 13 Sept 2025 - 113 continuous days - a foreign-registered jet was parked at this field, and in those 113 days SU-BND flew exactly twice, both Provo->Provo round-robins. TYLER ROBINSON IS CHARGED IN THIS KILLING, HAS NOT BEEN CONVICTED, AND NOTHING IN THIS ROW ASSERTS OTHERWISE.
